shots.purpose: Begin inside the heart-note before the audience can name the place; make uncertainty tactile, not explained.
shots.performanceAssignment: The water skin barely holds the reflected glow together: tiny uneven tremors pull the broken shapes apart, then surface tension gathers them back into one thin, soft-moving pulse. The pulse does not burst; it presses outward with a fragile confidence, leaving the original reflection quieter behind it.
shots.camera: The camera listens from within the surface, nearly still and shallow, letting the tremble be the subject rather than searching for geography.
shots.openingPose: A crystal-lit reflection trembles on dark water so close that the reflected world is only broken glow and liquid surface.
shots.cutInMotivation: Cutting to the answering facet gives the note a new sensory idea — sound finding light. Remaining continuous on the water would make the pulse feel like a water effect instead of Crystal Cove answering.
shots.visualPayoff: The broken glow stretches into a faint traveling line across the water, as if the note has found somewhere to go.
prohibited: Keep the frame extremely close on dark water and broken reflected glow; do not reveal geography or characters.
The pulse must press outward gently with a fading tail, never burst, flash, or behave like a shockwave.
Preserve the almost-still listening camera so the tremble itself remains the subject.

continuityOut.lighting: A fragile traveling line of glow has left the original reflection quieter behind it, moving outward across the water surface.
continuityOut.cameraSide: A fragile traveling line of glow has left the original reflection quieter behind it, moving outward across the water surface.

shots.continuityProseOut: A fragile traveling line of glow has left the original reflection quieter behind it, moving outward across the water surface.
shots.dialogueTimingProse: No dialogue; the shot breathes on the held unresolved note, the irregular tremble, and the delayed soft pulse outward.
shots.referenceRolesProse: Crystal Cove water/glow look references anchor the liquid surface, reflected crystal light, and shallow darkness; no character identity reference is involved.
shots.principalPerformanceApproved: The unseen note holds just shy of resolution; the glow answers with a tiny quiver that cannot quite steady itself.
shots.animationTimingApproved: Begin with a held, irregular tremble that feels like an inhale trying not to shake. Let the outward pulse arrive only after the glow has almost steadied, then travel gently with a fading tail rather than a flash.

shots.purpose: Let Crystal Cove answer the private signal without turning the title into a scenic tour.
shots.performanceAssignment: The facet receives the traveling line as a small internal catch: light runs through it too quickly, swells at the edge, then pulls itself back before releasing a gentler echo. The nearby suspended particles respond with a slight drift outward, as if nudged by the facet’s eager breath.
shots.camera: The camera stays compressed and attentive, making the facet feel like an instrument receiving the note rather than an object being displayed.
shots.openingPose: A close crystal facet catches the same wavering glow, with only a few suspended particles visible around its edge.
shots.cutInMotivation: The cut follows the changed sensory handoff — light finding water. Staying continuous would over-map the space and weaken the treatment’s intimacy by turning the moment into geography.
shots.visualPayoff: The facet’s echo spills downward as a pale ribbon of reflected light, aimed back toward the water.
prohibited: Keep the shot close and compressed on the facet; avoid turning it into a wide Crystal Cove tour.
The first glow response must feel a touch too eager, then visibly pull back before the gentler release.
Suspended particles should drift only slightly from the facet’s nudge, not become a separate magical effect.

shots.purpose: Discover the title where reflection and glow finally align, while keeping one small tremble of cost.
shots.performanceAssignment: The returning ribbon touches the water and the surface overreacts, wrinkling the almost-readable title into friendly distortion. The water then dampens its own ripple, line by line, until the letters can hold; one outer edge keeps a tiny tremble, the feeling not fully put away.
shots.camera: The camera waits in place for the title to be found; its stillness lets the ripple’s over-eager correction carry the friendliness.
shots.openingPose: The water surface holds a faint, almost-readable title reflection as the returning ribbon of crystal light approaches it.
shots.cutInMotivation: The title has completed the ceremonial promise and must hand cleanly to story action. Remaining continuous after the shimmer would overhold the feeling and turn bittersweetness into sentiment.
shots.visualPayoff: The title sits clear in the reflection, the glow steady around it, with one last unresolved shimmer trembling at the edge.
prohibited: The title must resolve as a reflection in water, not as flat graphic text pasted over the image.
Let the returning ribbon briefly wrinkle the almost-readable title before it settles cleanly enough to read.
Preserve one small unresolved edge-shimmer after the title clears; do not smooth the feeling completely away.
